text:
Nina: Thinking about a tiny-launch sequence for the new refapp CLI examples. Goal: a 2-week drip: launch post, two tutorial posts, a benchmark highlight, and a live walkthrough webinar for community devs. Low friction signup funnel.
Raj: Love it. For the benchmark highlight, I'll do a short narrative comparing cold vs warm starts, and include a chart of median latency by sequence length. Need sample logs from eng.
Tom: I can write the launch post + social copy. Propose a punchy title: 'Try the Tiny Refapp: fast local inference that scales'. Will draft by Thu.
Leah: I'll own the two tutorial posts. One will be "first steps with refapp-cli" and second is "optimizing inference costs with batching & caching". Both will include code snippets and a small lab exercise.
signup-bot: New list created: "refapp-cli-drip-2025"
Nina: Inbound routing plan: single form → hubspot list = refapp-cli-drip-2025, tag = refapp_cli_drip, utm_campaign=refapp_cli_launch_may2025. Set autoresponder to include repo, sandbox link, and calendar invite for webinar.
Raj: For graphs I9ll provide a PNG + alt text; can someone add a small explainer textbox on the landing page about methodology and hardware profile?
Tom: Yep, will add a methodology callout and link to the reproducibility notebook. Also will add TL;DR bullets for execs.
Leah: For the tutorials, suggest interactive code blocks and step-by-step CLI output. Also add a "try it now" badge linking to the sandbox.
Nina: Owners: Tom=launch post+social, Leah=tutorials, Raj=benchmarks, Nina=event/webinar + routing. Deadlines: PRs by next Wed.
Tom: Quick Q: which channels should we announce in? Community Slack, Twitter, DevX newsletter. Suggest also cross-posting to the OSS forum.
Nina: Agree. Also coordinate with partnerships for cross-post.
signup-bot: Autoresponder template saved: "refapp_cli_autoresp_v1"
Leah: I'll prep hands-on slides and a 12-minute demo script for the webinar.
Raj: I'll include a benchmark one-pager for the host slides.
Nina: Nice. Let's sync Thurs 10am to review assets.
